meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 装好后为 NanoClaw 加上 Telegram 机器人通道：拷入 Telegram 适配器、配对与 markdown 清洗辅助代码及测试，注册适配器、安装依赖并构建。完成后你可以在 Telegram 私聊或群聊里和 Claude 对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 通道时触发：它先构建并运行注册测试，再引导你创建机器人、存入 token、重启服务，最后完成 4 位配对码握手。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 通道加到 NanoClaw 上。
say.note: 会拷入适配器并注册，之后引导建机器人和配对。

say.text: 用我的机器人 token 配置 Telegram，然后开始配对。
say.note: token 存进 .env，接着打印 4 位配对码。

say.text: 检查一下 Telegram 通道有没有注册成功。

howto.what_en: Adds a Telegram bot channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter, pairing and markdown helpers with tests, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, and runs the registration test. You can then chat with Claude over Telegram.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a Telegram channel to NanoClaw. It builds and runs the registration test, then guides you through bot creation, storing the token, restarting, and pairing.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers it, then guides setup.

say_en.text: Configure Telegram with my bot token and start pairing.
say_en.note: Stores the token in .env, then issues a 4-digit code.

say_en.text: Check whether the Telegram channel registered correctly.
